text: The Ruins of Uldum (formerly just Uldum) is an ancient hall of stone located in the southern part of the Valley of the Watchers, in the desert of Tanaris. The ruins are full of Sandstone Earthen, who are immobile (if unprovoked) and malfunctioning. The western side of the room has been damaged, revealing a titan device. The Antediluvean Chest can be found in the back of the room. Tampering with the chest summons the Antechamber Guardian. The area appears to also be known as the "Antechamber of Uldum" and may have once been the grand entrance to Uldum itself. The quakes that ripped its doors open probably collapsed the tunnels. Members of both the Explorers' League and the Reliquary are seeking the ancient mogu artifacts held within. However, the rapid expansion of the mine has awakened hostile mogu and neutral pandaren ghosts, preventing workers from getting their tasks done. Rudy Koch is a former Blizzard Entertainment employee who worked as a Senior Producer on World of Warcraft. He has also streamed games under the name Sancho9000. Koch joined Blizzard in September 2016, having previously worked at Activision for 5 years on titles including , and . Koch left Blizzard in 2018 to co-found the game studio and technology company Mythical Games, whose titles include Blankos Block Party and NFL Rivals. He is a named inventor on more than thirty granted US patents covering digital item ownership and in-game marketplaces. As of 2026 he is co-founder and CEO of JOA, a company building interactive products for live sports.

Rulesets are sets of rules or game mechanics that constrain, direct, and operate within a game. World of Warcraft has four types of rulesets that apply to various servers (or realms). They are predefined for each server. The game contents are all the same. * PvE (Player versus Environment) require you to flag yourself to engage in PvP combat. * PvP (Player versus Player) makes you always flagged when in contested or enemy zones. * RP (Role-Playing) is a PvE subset that promotes roleplaying and limits out of character conversation for a more immersive experience. * RPPvP is the PvP version of the RP subset.

Rune of Cinderglacier is a Death Knight rune that can be inscribed on a Death Knight's weapon through runeforging. Sometimes used by dual-wield frost DKs to boost their AoE damage.

Rune of Razorice is a death knight frost rune that can be made through runeforging. Frost death knights will use this on their off-hand weapon (with Rune of the Fallen Crusader on the main hand) to boost their frost damage on single target fights.
Rune of Lichbane is a Death knight blood rune that can be made through runeforging.
Rune of Spellbreaking is a Death knight rune that can be made through runeforging.
Rune of Swordbreaking is a Death knight rune that can be made through runeforging.
Rune of the Fallen Crusader is a death knight unholy rune that can be applied to a weapon through runeforging.
Rumbleshot's Ammo is looted from the Ammo Crate southwest of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.
Runecaster's Bracers is a quest reward from A Score to Settle, A Score to Settle (2), and Ears of the Lich King.

The Runed Titanium Rod is the rod needed by enchanters in Wrath of the Lich King for higher level end-game enchants. Most enchants that are trained at the beginning make use of the Runed Eternium Rod from The Burning Crusade expansion, however later enchants will require this rod instead.
The Rune Sample is provided as an objective for The Lodestone.
Runed Harness is provided as an objective for The Last of Her Kind.
Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle is a death knight rune that can be made through runeforging. It is the only recommended runeforge for death knight tanks.
The Runed Azurite Rod was a tool for Enchanting made of Azurite. It was never made available.

Rune of Distortion is provided as an objective by Thassarian or Koltira Deathweaver in Icecrown. It is used to summon Grimkor the Wicked.
The Runed Ring of Binding is an epic tanking ring that drops from the 10-man level 80 version of Onyxia.

Rune of the Nerubian Carapace is a death knight rune that can be made through runeforging. It is the one-handed equivalent to Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle, intended for use by death knight tanks. Originally, this rune gave 13 Defense skill (compared to the 25 of the Stoneskin Gargoyle), but after the removal of the Defense stat in Patch 4.0.1, the bonus was changed to Armor instead.
__NOTOC__ Rumbling Exiles are earth elementals that can be found at the Circle of Inner Binding in the Arathi Highlands. They are also present during the Battle for Stromgarde.
The Rune of Finite Variation is a quest reward from Mystery of the Infinite, Redux.
Runeforged Sentries are iron golems found while fighting your way through the Formation Grounds in Ulduar.
Rule of Law is a Retribution talent that increases the critical effect chance on Crusader Strike, Holy Shock and Word of Glory.
The Rune of Jin'yael is located in Azshara. It was set up by Jin'yael.
The Rune of Beth'Amara is located in Azshara. It was set up by Sael'hai.
The Rune of Sael'hai is located in Azshara. It was set up by Sael'hai.
The Rune of Markri is located in Azshara. It was set up by Markri.
The Runed Elementium Rod can be created by enchanters after learning and is used to make high-skill enchants that require a .
Rune of Fire is provided as an objective for Pushing Forward.
The Runed Dragonscale was created with Inscription (505); taught by trainers.
Rumbling Earths are earth elementals found in the Stormwind Stockade.

The Rumbling Terrace can be found between Zhu's Descent and the Winds' Edge south-east of the Silken Fields and south of the Yan-Zhe River in the Valley of the Four Winds. Galleon and the Salyis's Warband riding his back spawn here on occasion.
Rumpus Combatants are pandaren located in the Ring of Inner Focus in the Jade Forest. They are assistants of Instructor Myang.
Rumpus Brutes are pandaren located in the Ring of Inner Focus in the Jade Forest. He is assistant of Instructor Myang.

Rulagos was one of the blue dragons charged with moving the Focusing Iris to a secure location. He and his sister, Rulagosa, appeared in human form as twins. He was killed along with the other escorts by members of the Horde who wished to steal the artifact.

Rulagosa was one of the blue dragons charged with moving the Focusing Iris to a secure location. She and her brother, Rulagos, appeared in human form as twins. She was killed along with the other escorts by members of the Horde who wished to steal the artifact.

Rumblefitz was a goblin alchemist who was hired by Zhahara Darksquall to find the Pearl of Pandaria. He was partnered to the ogre Blokk. On a personal level, Rumblefitz worked with Zhahara because she promised him access to the rare alchemical texts hidden within the libraries on the Wandering Isle. By his own admission, he had a habit of talking too much and people couldn't tell when he was kidding; he'd been told he was "unreadable."

Rumbles of Thunder is an exploration achievement earned for interacting with the lore objects on the Isle of Thunder that tell the tale of Lei Shen. Upon interaction with the fourth lore object, adventurers will immediately gain 2000 reputation with the Lorewalkers, and sends a letter via the in-game mail system: Attached is Rumbles of Thunder (item), which begins a quest, Rumbles of Thunder (quest).
Rumbling Earth Elementals were earth elementals attacking major cities.
Run with the Wind is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Ner'onok in Siege of Niuzao Temple on Heroic difficulty while under the effect of Tenwu's Resolve.

Rumble in the Jungle is a weekly quest offered by at the Saberstalkers' camp north of Fang'rila. Along with Tooth and Claw (quest), it is one of two repeatable quests that grant reputation with the Saberstalkers.
Rulkrik the Pillager is an orc located at Zeth'Kur in Tanaan Jungle.
Rukmaz's Vault is a arakkoa vault containing an ancient titan relic which the Alliance and Horde fought over in the connected cavern by the Breach.
Runas' Last Copper is fished from the fountain in Dalaran at the Broken Isles.

__NOTOC__ The Runeaxe Training Grounds is a small sparring area located with the Runewood of Stormheim. The grounds are used by the Bonespeaker Runeaxes to hone their skills in battle, and can be found close to the local Bonespeaker village of Akstad.
Runa Rageeye is an orcish warlock found in Dreadscar Rift. She is accompanied by the felhound Bauxosh.
Runelord Ragnar is a vrykul located in Stormheim. Ragnar is one of three rune bearers which is used to imprison Malace Shade, the others being the Runesage Floki and the Runeskeld Rollo.
Runes for Dummies: Arcane is a book found in the Chamber of the Guardian of Dalaran during the quest Dabbling in the Demonic.
The Runed Journal Page is gathered from Fjarnskaggl in the Broken Isles.
